name: Royal Automation & Controls
old_description: We carry all the top manufacturers and brands in the business
about:
Royal Automation & Controls operates in Salt Lake City, Utah, and has served the Wasatch Front since 1957. The branch is part of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network with more than 700 locations, and functions as a wholesale supplier of electrical equipment and automation solutions.

The company stocks a broad range of industrial controls and automation hardware, including variable-frequency drives, PLCs, SCADA platforms, explosion-proof enclosures, push buttons, and switchgear. It provides VFD programming and start-up commissioning, switchgear and lighting quotations, project management support, and a delivery service for local customers. Inventory is maintained on-site to support same-day or next-day fulfillment for contractors and panel builders.

Customers span industrial and agricultural contractors, OEMs, panel builders, system integrators, and municipal water and wastewater facilities. The branch also serves the mining, metals, and minerals sector and the oil and gas industry across the Intermountain region. Its sales team works directly with electrical contractors and facility maintenance departments on both new construction and MRO projects.

Royal Automation & Controls emphasizes its role as a single-source partner anchored by a long-standing relationship with Schneider Electric, carrying the full Altivar drive lineup, Square D switchgear, and Harmony operator interfaces. A dedicated industrial sales staff, rapid response times, and local delivery are cited as the primary reasons contractors rely on the branch for day-to-day and project-critical needs.
